description: This file defines the HomeFragment widget for a Flutter app, primarily implementing a map-based interface that shows user location, ride routes, rider markers, and ride status. It manages state related to location, ride progression, rider approaches, and destination selection. The code includes map initialization, reverse geocoding, route drawing, rider simulation, and ride lifecycle management, tailored for a ride-hailing scenario.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: A StatefulWidget representing the main map-based home screen with ride features.

classes.name: _HomeFragmentState
classes.description: State class managing map, location, ride progress, rider simulation, and UI interactions.

methods.name: _getCurrentLocation
methods.description: Fetches user's current GPS location, handles permissions, reverse geocodes it, and centers map.

methods.name: _reverseGeocode
methods.description: Converts latitude and longitude into a human-readable address string.

methods.name: _initializeMarkers
methods.description: Creates initial rider markers near the user's location.

methods.name: _buildGoogleMap
methods.description: Builds the GoogleMap widget with configuration and error handling.

methods.name: _onCameraIdle
methods.description: Triggered when map camera stops; reverse geocodes center position after debounce.

methods.name: _buildBottomPanel
methods.description: Builds the bottom UI with location info and ride controls.

methods.name: _openLocationSearch
methods.description: Opens bottom sheet for selecting destination.

methods.name: _onDestinationSelected
methods.description: Handles user-selected destination: geocode, markers, route drawing, zoom, and UI updates.

methods.name: _drawRoutePolyline
methods.description: Creates and draws a polyline representing route from user location to destination.

methods.name: _generateRoutePoints
methods.description: Helper to generate intermediate points for curved route visualization.

methods.name: _fitMapToRoute
methods.description: Adjusts map camera to encompass both origin and destination points.

methods.name: _showRideBottomSheet
methods.description: Displays ride booking and details bottom sheet.

methods.name: _startRiderApproach
methods.description: Simulates rider approach with timed marker updates.

methods.name: _onRiderArrived
methods.description: Handles rider arrival, shows prompt to start journey.

methods.name: _startJourney
methods.description: Simulates journey progress towards destination with timed marker updates.

methods.name: _onJourneyComplete
methods.description: Handles ride completion, navigates to celebration screen, resets state.
